about: The hand-written edges (tests/library-vectors/edges.ts): ties, cuts, JS's spaces, addresses with no URL, numbers, payload keys.

cases.about: edges: ties: two Settings items in a space used at the same time: the id first in localeCompare shown
edges: ties: a favorite with two items used at the same time: the one first in localeCompare (t-a before t-B) opened and reset
edges: ties: a favorite with no item, two items at its address: the first in the ids' order taken
edges: ties: a pin with two unbound items at its address, used at the same time; then one bound to it: the bound one
edges: ties: a space's front item: equal times, the selected one; equal times and none selected, localeCompare's first
edges: ties: spaces and link rules at equal orders, in localeCompare's order of their ids (a before B before b)
edges: ties: the archive at equal times, newest first then by id; restoring the last of a space
edges: ties: a clear of four or more items (more ids than the app gives) in the ids' order
edges: ties: items at equal places, one placed beside another (midpoints, the tight renumbering)
edges: cuts: names, titles, given titles and emoji cut through an emoji (the broken half dropped)
edges: spaces: JS's whitespace trimmed (U+FEFF, U+3000), not U+0085 nor U+180E
edges: addresses as the browsers parse them (Tirth's answer 11; Margin.app's JavaScriptCore had no URL): a trailing slash and a fragment make no other address; a link rule routes

edges: addresses as the browsers parse them: the host's case, the scheme's default port, dot segments and an empty query make no other address; the path's case and the scheme do; the archive keeps one entry an address; a *. rule routes its hosts only
edges: numbers: places and ratios as doubles, window ids as numbers and strings, now with a fraction
edges: payload keys: a number, an array as a tab id (JS's property keys), names that are the object prototype's
